subject: Kickoff: MAP & contracting playbook — Orbitalsys procurement contacts
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orbitalsys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-18T14:02:00Z
Subject: Kickoff: MAP & contracting playbook — Orbitalsys procurement contacts

Hi Liam — great to reconnect after the demo. As discussed, we'd like to kick off a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) to align milestones and identify the contracting gatekeepers so we can keep to the close timeline (target EoQ).

Quick summary of what we want to confirm in this thread: 
- Primary procurement/legal contacts for Orbitalsys and any preferred PO or SOW process
- Typical redline turnaround expectations (review windows for first pass)
- Any mandatory clauses or security artifacts (SOC2, DPA, IP addenda) that we should pre-seed in the MAP
- Proposed contracting milestones and an initial target dates column

I've looped in Marissa (Customer Success lead) and Rishi (Sales legal/contracting owner) from our side. Vivek will monitor the timeline for the dedicated capacity onboarding once contracting lands.

I've attached a draft MAP (spreadsheet) and a short guide on how we run redlines. Please introduce the appropriate procurement and legal owners or confirm the two people below if that's correct. If you prefer, we can schedule a 30-min contracting sync this week.

Attaching: 20270618_Redwood_MAP_v1.xlsx, redline_guidelines.pdf

Proposed first-pass milestones (subject to your calendar):
- Legal review / initial redline: by 2027-06-25
- Commercial review / pricing confirmation: by 2027-06-28
- Final redline & signatures: by 2027-07-08

Thanks — looking forward to getting this moving.

Best,
Chloe Martin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0124
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orbitalsys.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.singh@orbitalsys.com>, procurement@orbitalsys.com
Date: 2027-06-18T18:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & contracting playbook — Orbitalsys procurement contacts

Hi Chloe — thanks for the clear kickoff and the MAP draft. Confirming our primary contacts: 
- Procurement (POs / commercial): Priya Singh (procurement@orbitalsys.com) — cc'd
- Legal (contract redlines): Daniel Hsu (daniel.hsu@orbitalsys.com) — I didn't cc Daniel yet; he'll be on the thread going forward.

A couple of notes from our side:
- Our procurement team typically expects a 3 business-day turnaround for a first redline review; legal sometimes takes 5–7 business days depending on complexity.
- We require an executed DPA before production access; if you can share your latest SOC2 attestation and standard DPA, that will speed the path.
- We use a centralized DocuSign flow; please confirm if Redwood prefers DocuSign or a procurment-managed PO-first approach.

We can do a 30-min contracting alignment tomorrow 2027-06-19 at 10:00 PT if that works for your team.

Thanks,
Liam
Head of Partnerships | Orbitalsys
liam.oconnor@orbitalsys.com
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@orbitalsys.com>, Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-06-18T19:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Kickoff: MAP & contracting playbook — Orbitalsys procurement contacts

Thanks Liam — welcome, Daniel when you join. Quick notes from my side so we have expectations set: 
- We'll ingest redlines in Word (tracked changes) or as a marked-up PDF and aim for an internal 3–4 business-day first pass. If there are high-risk IP/data terms we should handle those upfront.
- Our standard exceptions matrix is attached in the redline_guidelines.pdf; it typically shortens legal cycles when shared early.
- Chloe / Marissa: if Orbitalsys prefers PO-first, we can accept a PO for initial licensing but require the DPA signed before production keys.

I'll plan to join the 2027-06-19 10:00 PT sync.

—Rishi
Contracts & Commercial Ops | Redwood Inference

Hi Priya / Daniel — thanks for taking this on. Quick run-of-show for tomorrow's 30-min sync (2027-06-19 10:00 PT):
1) Introductions (2–3 min)
2) Confirm contract owner and preferred redline format/process (5 min)
3) Walk the MAP milestones and flag any non-starters (10 min)
4) Agree on next steps / assign owners (10 min)

Please bring any required internal procurement checklist items (e.g., PO cadence, mandatory clauses). I've attached the MAP spreadsheet we referenced in the original note. If you prefer, I can remove optional clauses and send a slim redlineable draft before the meeting.

See you shortly —
Chloe
